en.title: The 6-month rule
en.subtitle: Airlines check this at check-in

steps.label: + 6 months
steps.text: Your passport must still be valid out here

en.note: Most countries count from the day you arrive, some from the day you leave
en.focal: Count from the later date: it covers both
en.alt: Timeline diagram of the 6-month passport rule: you arrive, your trip, you fly home, then six more months through which the passport must stay valid; most countries count from the day you arrive and some from the day you leave, so counting from the later date covers both
en.caption: Most countries count the six months from the day you arrive - counting from the later date covers you either way.
